about.heading: MISSION: CLARITY AS CARE
about.body: My practice is built on three nodes: Systems, Culture, and Clarity. I transform complex organizational narratives into functional design tools. Whether it's a brand system for a Philadelphia museum or a digital showcase for a university, I design for longevity, accessibility, and economic sovereignty.

sections.heading: ABOUT
sections.content: Carter Benoît-Myer is a systems designer and brand architect based in Philadelphia. With a background in graphic design and high-performance athletics, Carter brings disciplined rigor to visual infrastructure—building modular design systems for cultural institutions, mission-led brands, and community organizations.

projects.title: Brand System for the African American Museum of Philadelphia (AAMP)

content.abstract: Define the visual rules (type, marks, grid, color) so the museum can publish consistently across programs without design drift.
content.systemLogic: Center Black narratives with respect—no museum “dust.” Use design to keep the institution alive in the city’s present tense.
content.culturalContext: Deliverables: logo + wordmark, type system, color rules, templates (social, signage, print).

meta.tools: museum branding, cultural institution, brand system, Philadelphia
meta.keywords: brand systems, cultural preservation, clarity as care

projects.title: Editorial System for ROAM: International Skateboard Publication

content.abstract: Build a modular editorial system that highlights skateboarding as a geopolitical lens—revealing how communities form identity across borders, language, and political systems.
content.systemLogic: Design a layout framework that prioritizes photography and first-person narratives. The grid adapts to varied content while maintaining typographic discipline and visual rhythm.
content.culturalContext: ROAM documents skating communities in contested or marginalized spaces—from Gaza to Havana. The design treats these stories with journalistic rigor, avoiding exoticization. The system emphasizes commonalities over politics.

meta.tools: editorial design, skate publication, layout system
meta.keywords: editorial systems, humanitarian design, geopolitical narratives, typographic hierarchy

content.systemLogic: Honor cultural legacy without over-stylizing. Design acts as a frame for the work and its context.
